local.title: Open Claude Code
local.body:
Open the Claude desktop app and click </> at the top to switch to Claude Code.

If it was already open, quit it and open it again so it lists the new connection.
local.alt: Screenshot · Claude Code switch at the top of the sidebar

local.title: Choose Eggie
local.body:
1. Click This computer under the prompt box.
  2. Under SSH, select Eggie.
local.alt: Screenshot · environment menu with Eggie under SSH

local.title: Start prompting
local.body:
Claude Code opens in your kitchen's projects folder. The first time, it may take a minute to install what it needs there.

Then tell it what to build.
local.alt: Screenshot · Claude Code prompt on Eggie, in the projects folder

local.title: Open Claude Code
local.body: Open the Claude Code app and sign in.

local.title: Switch to WSL
local.body:
1. Open the environment menu next to the prompt box.
  2. Select WSL.
  3. Choose eggie-vm from the list.

local.title: Start prompting
local.body: Tell Claude Code what to build.
local.alt: Screenshot · Claude Code prompt, connected to the kitchen
